title: Totem advancements
summary: New advancements for the Dungeon Totems: be saved by them, collect every kind, try every animal form, cure yourself of zombification and stack them. Four new challenges ask you to carry a full stack, or ride the train as a zombie, for the long haul, and you can track them.
highlights: Totems now only stack when you place one on top of another
The Totem of Loneliness is now the Totem of Generosity
